data.code:
import sys,json,sqlite3
call=json.load(sys.stdin)
con=sqlite3.connect(call["ledger_uri"],uri=True)
for ref in call["inputs"]:
    item=json.loads(con.execute("SELECT data FROM entries WHERE id=?",(ref,)).fetchone()[0])
    print(json.dumps({"kind":"output","data":{"echo":item["text"]}},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
con.close()
print(json.dumps({"kind":"end","data":{"reason":"echo_submitted"}}),flush=True)
